sloka: स्वनन्ति पादपाः च इमे माम् अनङ्ग प्रदीपकाः ।अशोक स्तबक अङ्गारः षट्पद स्वन निस्वनः ॥४-१-२९॥
transliteration: svananti pādapāḥ ca ime mām anaṅga pradīpakāḥ ।aśoka stabaka aṅgāraḥ ṣaṭpada svana nisvanaḥ ॥4-1-29॥

translations.english: 'The fire of spring with clusters of Asoka flowers as its charcoal, its coppercoloured tender leaves as flames, the buzz of bees as its crackle will, as if, consume me.
